```python
import narwhals as nw
import polars as pl

# Create sample DataFrame
df = nw.from_native(
    pl.DataFrame({"spend": [500, 1000, 1500, 999, 2000, 100]})
)

# Add tier column using conditional expression
df = df.with_columns(
    tier=nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000).then("gold").otherwise("standard")
)

print(df.to_native())
```
